question: What Are the Thermocouple Types and Ranges?
body_html:
Thermocouple types are the eight standard types J, K, T, E, N, S, R and B defined by IEC 60584 and ASTM E230, each using a different pair of alloys.

FamilyTypesKey point
Base metalJ, K, T, E, NLow cost, most processes up to about 1,260 °C
Noble metalS, R, BPlatinum alloys, up to 1,820 °C

Type K is the most widely used, covering −270 °C to +1,260 °C, while Type T is the best choice below 0 °C.
